sources.title: OpenRAL/rskill-robometer_4b-any-general-nf4 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: OpenRAL rSkill — Robometer-4B (Qwen3-VL-4B robotic reward foundation model) packaged as an NF4 bitsandbytes reward rSkill. Given a rollout's RGB frames plus the task instruction, it emits per-frame normalized progress (0–1) and per-frame success probability, queried on demand by the Reasoner.
